evidence.name: Screen field: Tint The Phone's Top Bar
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Tint The Phone's Top Bar" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Tint The Phone's Top Bar
sections.description: Sets the color of the surrounding system bars on web funnels, the strip at the top showing time and battery, and the bottom address bar. Leave it unset for almost every screen so it inherits your onboarding default. Set a color only when you want the phone's frame to blend into a full-bleed background for a seamless look.
